protocol.primary: forty-yard post-onset half-second burst -> context-adjusted rookie LOS-crossing time
protocol.secondary: same functional on predeclared front starts, with drill nuisance adjustment
protocol.decision_rule: shortlist lowest predicted quartile per class; hit = target below training lower quartile
protocol.source_noise: estimated from independent repeat attempts; branch ranges are descriptive
protocol.availability: all five raw drill flags and attempt counts shared by every model
protocol.NGS: strong comparator includes supplied draft grades under declared pre-draft interpretation; repeat without NGS
protocol.context: starting LOS depth, width, speed, situation and alignment; fit on training athletes only
protocol.NFL_horizon: rookie regular season; training seasons strictly before evaluated class
protocol.2025: previously inspected development evidence, never a fresh holdout
protocol.candidate_status: protocol is fixed before this new experiment, but the data have prior adaptive use

onset_identification.explanation: X n = 0 but h.n != 0: beta and beta+n fit every observation

travel_identification.explanation: X n = 0 but h.n != 0: beta and beta+n fit every observation

exact_los_confounding.scope: linear witness concerns onset plus travel; acceleration nonuniqueness is exhibited separately

declared_travel_box.model: d = v*t + a*t^2/2; independent nonnegative d,v box and positive a box

scope: Analytic mathematics and implementation checks only. No new NFL prediction result.
